blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS — Jaden McDaniels scored 25 points, Ayo Dosunmu added 19 and the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the short-handed Memphis Grizzlies 104-95 on Saturday night. Jonathan Kuminga scored 16 points, Terrence Shannon Jr. added 15 and LaMelo Ball had 12 as Minnesota shot a season-high 58% from the field. Minnesota has won three of four; however, it continues searching for consistent offensive flow without injured Anthony Edwards. The Timberwolves had 23 turnovers after having 17 and 21 in its prior two games.
